title: Canada seeks new role in global economy
summary: As trade ties with the US continue to fray, Canada is seeking a new role and new partners in the increasingly fragmented global economy. Prime Minister Mark Carney has been courting more foreign investment as well as closer ties with the European Union and Asian economies.

title: Thousands protest in Madrid against Spain’s housing crisis
summary: Thousands of protesters in Madrid demand answers after the eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal.

title: Four US TV networks to resume coverage of Trump events — NYT
summary: According to the newspaper, ABC, CBS, Fox News, and NBC will return to their press pool duties on Sunday
